latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: pdflatex in .build named by folder
args: Set-Location -LiteralPath '%DIR%'; $out = '%OUTDIR%'; $job = Split-Path -Leaf '%DIR%'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; & pdflatex -synctex=1 -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error "-output-directory=$out" "-jobname=$job" '%DOC%'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
